description: Presidential Secretariat - Confer the Vishista Sewa Vibhushanaya by the President
categorisation: This gazette exclusively lists named military personnel (Lieutenant Generals, Major Generals, Vice Admirals, etc.) who are being conferred the Vishista Sewa Vibhushanaya award. It contains specific individual names and their ranks but provides NO details about their portfolio responsibilities, duties, or government structural changes. This fits the definition of a People Gazette (Type 2) as it involves government personnel changes (awards/conferments) without any description of what they are responsible for.
